description: Check whether a form will accept a file, from the file's facts: its real type (from its contents, not its name), size in bytes, and pixel size or PDF page count. Give either rules or a requirement id from find_upload_requirements (with the upload name for multi-upload forms, such as "ibps/signature"). The file itself is never sent. Returns each rule as passed or failed, and where to fix it.

type.description: The real type from the file's contents.

requirement.description: A requirement id, such as "us-visa" or "ibps/signature".

rules.description: The form's rules, when there is no requirement id.

file_name.description: How files should be named, such as "Lastname_ID".

for.description: Who is asking for the files, such as "ABC Lettings".

max_files.description: How many files the form takes.

max_kb.description: Largest allowed size per file, in KB (2 MB = 2000).

max_pages.description: Most pages allowed in a PDF.

min_kb.description: Smallest allowed size per file, in KB.

note.description: A short note for the person, such as "Both sides of your ID, please."

what.description: What the files are for, such as "Rental application".

name: check_file
title: Check a file against a form’s rules
